scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @extratime/api" "npm run dev -w @extratime/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @extratime/shared && npm run build -w @extratime/api -w @extratime/web
scripts.demo: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @extratime/api" "npm run preview -w @extratime/web"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
